latestVersion.changelog:
JCPPT-PLACE 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Enables one-stop automatic creation of Journal Club PPTs from academic paper PDFs.
- Extracts title, authors, background, results, images, and discussion directly from uploaded PDFs (supports top journals).
- Conducts automated background research and integrates authoritative literature context.
- Pulls out all figures and captions, storing images with consistent naming in a dedicated directory.
- Generates a ready-to-use PPTX using an academic blue-gold template with structured, bilingual slides.
- Follows strict quality standards for scientific accuracy, formatting, and citation throughout the workflow.
